editorial.tldr: Five unrelated arXiv papers share only the phrase "empirical study" in their titles; this is not one developing story. They span clinical-protocol coding agents (Oct 13), attack triage (Oct 21), UML hallucinations, Vietnamese classification, and KG-to-text (Oct 22).
editorial.whats_new: Oct 22 adds a UML-diagram hallucination taxonomy and a Vietnamese decision-model transfer study alongside the KG-to-text benchmark.
editorial.why_it_matters: No shared finding links these papers; the hallucination taxonomy for generated UML is the one most relevant to teams using LLMs for design artifacts.
editorial.take_for_builders: Skip unless a paper matches your domain; if you generate UML or design docs with an LLM, check the hallucination taxonomy against your own outputs.
